# UWTSD Research Repository

> An institutional open-access repository for University of Wales Trinity Saint David research publications, theses, and scholarly outputs built on EPrints 3 platform.

The UWTSD Research Repository serves as the central hub for discovering and accessing peer-reviewed research, academic papers, and theses produced by the university's faculty and research centers. It implements OAI 2.0 protocol compliance and supports open access principles across multiple research divisions and subject areas.

- Institutional Repository

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to the Research Repository](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk): Homepage for UWTSD Research Repository, institutional open-access platform
- [About the Repository](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/information.html): About page describing UWTSD repository, EPrints 3 platform, and deposit information

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse by Subject](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/view/subjects): Subject-based browsing using Library of Congress classification system
- [Browse by Author](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/view/authors): Alphabetical author directory for UWTSD research publications
- [Browse by Year](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/view/year): Chronological browsing interface for UWTSD research publications
- [Browse by Division and Year](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/view/divisions): Browse UWTSD research centers and institutes including Hardy Centre
- [Latest 20 Additions to Research Repository](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/cgi/latest_tool): Feed of latest 20 additions to UWTSD research repository

## Policies & Accessibility

- [Accessibility statement for Research Repository](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/accessibility.html): WCAG accessibility statement with screen reader support details
- [Takedown Policy](https://repository.uwtsd.ac.uk/takedown_policy.html): Content removal and intellectual property complaint process policy
